units.source: Insert buttons
Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__ to reveal special inserable items and blocks such as symbols, Math expressions and separators.
Bookmarks__TRILIUM_PH_0__
See the dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_0__Anchors__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section.
New child note__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__New child note__TRILIUM_PH_2__ to create an empty child note of the current note and insert a link to it at the cursor. The new note opens in __TRILIUM_PH_3__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_4__ with its title selected, so typing names it, and the link shows the new title. While the note is still empty, Quick edit offers the note types to turn it into.
The same action is available as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Create a new child note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_3__. A child note of a protected note is protected too.
Emoji__TRILIUM_PH_0__
This feature allows inserting Unicode emoji characters. Simply select a category and a desired emoji to insert it.
Emojis can also be searched by their English name and the skin tone can be selected via a combo box to the right.

There is also the possibility of inserting emojis directly by typing __TRILIUM_PH_0__ followed by a name of an emoji, triggering the display of a list of emojis. Simply use the arrow keys to select one and press __TRILIUM_PH_1__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_2__ or __TRILIUM_PH_3__Tab__TRILIUM_PH_4__ to insert it.
Symbols__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button will reveal a popup window displaying a list of characters that are generally more difficult to insert directly from the keyboard, such as a subset of emojis, quotation characters, etc.
Interaction:
Click on a character to insert it at the current cursor position.
The window can be dragged around by the top bar where the title is, to avoid it getting in the way of the text.
Click on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Category__TRILIUM_PH_1__ selector to filter the characters.
Multicolumn layout__TRILIUM_PH_0__
See the dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_0__Multicolumn layout__TRILIUM_PH_1__ page.
Extended code block__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Extended code block__TRILIUM_PH_2__ to insert a code block that is edited as a code note. This entry is experimental and is shown only once it is turned on. See __TRILIUM_PH_3__Extended code blocks__TRILIUM_PH_4__ in __TRILIUM_PH_5__Code blocks__TRILIUM_PH_6__.
Math equations__TRILIUM_PH_0__
See the dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_0__Math Equations__TRILIUM_PH_1__ page.
Drawing canvas__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Drawing canvas__TRILIUM_PH_2__ to draw on an Excalidraw canvas inside the text. See __TRILIUM_PH_3__Drawing canvases__TRILIUM_PH_4__ in __TRILIUM_PH_5__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_6__.
Mermaid diagram__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button to create an inline Mermaid diagram. The arrow next to it lists a template for each kind of diagram. The diagram is also available as __TRILIUM_PH_1__Mermaid diagram__TRILIUM_PH_2__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_4__.

This feature is quite similar to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mermaid Diagrams__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note types and is meant as an alternative to it for simple diagrams. For more complex diagrams, use the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_3__ feature for a dedicated Mermaid note.

A diagram shows in a box like the one of an included note, so it can be resized, given another box size (__TRILIUM_PH_0__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Full__TRILIUM_PH_3__) from its __TRILIUM_PH_4__ __TRILIUM_PH_5__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_6__ menu or shown in fullscreen, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_7__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_8__.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button at the start of the diagram's toolbar decides whether its source can be changed. While it is off, the source still shows, but read-only.

The buttons next to it choose what the diagram shows, as for a Mermaid note: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Source view__TRILIUM_PH_2__ for the Mermaid source alone, __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Split view__TRILIUM_PH_5__ for the source with the diagram next to it, and __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__Preview__TRILIUM_PH_8__ for the diagram alone. Its __TRILIUM_PH_9__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_10__ menu offers the same choice.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Word wrap__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Line numbers__TRILIUM_PH_3__ submenus of its __TRILIUM_PH_4__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_5__ menu change how the source shows, each with __TRILIUM_PH_6__Auto__TRILIUM_PH_7__, __TRILIUM_PH_8__On__TRILIUM_PH_9__ and __TRILIUM_PH_10__Off__TRILIUM_PH_11__, as for an included code note (see __TRILIUM_PH_12__Editing an include in place__TRILIUM_PH_13__ in __TRILIUM_PH_14__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_15__).

A new diagram starts editable, in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Split view__TRILIUM_PH_1__. The diagram updates a moment after you stop typing. If the source has an error, the error shows over the last diagram that worked, which stays dimmed, as in a Mermaid note. On desktop, drag the divider between the source and the diagram to resize them.

A diagram without a chosen view shows the source next to the diagram while it is editable, and the diagram alone otherwise. In a read-only note, the source can never be changed. A read-only note and the AI chat show a diagram in the same box, in the view it was saved with, and with the zoom buttons over the diagram instead of in a toolbar. A __TRILIUM_PH_0__Medium__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Full__TRILIUM_PH_3__ diagram also has a __TRILIUM_PH_4__ __TRILIUM_PH_5__Fullscreen__TRILIUM_PH_6__ button there, or over the source in the __TRILIUM_PH_7__Source__TRILIUM_PH_8__ view.

To zoom, use the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ and __TRILIUM_PH_1__ buttons of the diagram's toolbar; the zoom level between them resets the zoom. In fullscreen, where the toolbar is hidden, the same buttons show over the diagram. Drag the diagram to move around it, and double-click it to reset the view. The mouse wheel scrolls the note until you click the diagram, and then zooms it.

While the source shows, the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Mermaid syntax help__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button at the end of the toolbar opens the help on __TRILIUM_PH_3__Mermaid Diagrams__TRILIUM_PH_4__, which links to the Mermaid syntax.

The changes made to the source of a diagram are part of the undo history of the text note, in the order they were made. __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Z__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__+__TRILIUM_PH_6__Y__TRILIUM_PH_7__ undo and redo them from the source as well as from the text, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_8__Editing an include in place__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in __TRILIUM_PH_10__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_11__.
The source of the diagram stays in the note as a Mermaid code block, so the diagram is exported to Markdown as a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ code block that other applications can show.
Diagrams created in earlier versions keep the view they were saved with, and open editable.
Audio/video embed__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Audio/video embed__TRILIUM_PH_2__ to insert a YouTube video, or an audio or video file from its web address, that can be played inside the note. Paste the address, then press __TRILIUM_PH_3__Insert media__TRILIUM_PH_4__ or __TRILIUM_PH_5__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_6__. The media is inserted as a link preview in the __TRILIUM_PH_7__Embed__TRILIUM_PH_8__ display mode, described in __TRILIUM_PH_9__Link Previews__TRILIUM_PH_10__. The same action is available as __TRILIUM_PH_11__Audio/video embed__TRILIUM_PH_12__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_13__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_14__.
Horizontal ruler__TRILIUM_PH_0__

This feature will display a horizontal line, generally useful to separate different sections of the text. To do so, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__.
Alternatively, it's possible to insert a horizontal ruler by typing __TRILIUM_PH_0__.
Page break__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Page breaks provide a way to force the next paragraph or block (table, image, etc.) to be displayed onto the next page when printing (either to a real printer to __TRILIUM_PH_0__when exporting to PDF__TRILIUM_PH_1__).
Page breaks are marked in the editor with the words __TRILIUM_PH_0__Page break__TRILIUM_PH_1__, but they will not actually be shown when printed.
To insert a page break, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in the formatting toolbar.

To insert many page breaks at once, insert a page break first, click on it and press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__C__TRILIUM_PH_3__. Then use __TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__+__TRILIUM_PH_6__V__TRILIUM_PH_7__, to paste as many times as needed.
Footnotes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
See the dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_0__Footnotes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ page.
Date and time__TRILIUM_PH_0__

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button inserts the current date and time at the cursor, replacing the selected text if there is any. The inserted text takes the formatting of the text around it, so a date inserted inside bold text is bold too.
To insert the date in the default format, press the button itself or press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__T__TRILIUM_PH_3__.

To insert it in another format, press the arrow next to the button and pick a format from the list. Each entry shows the current date and time in that format: the default one, the date or the time alone, the date written out, and ISO 8601.

The same formats are offered by the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_1__: type __TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__ or __TRILIUM_PH_5__. The __TRILIUM_PH_6__Insert date/time__TRILIUM_PH_7__ entry uses the default format, and shows what it inserts underneath; the other entries show their output in the title.

The default format can be changed in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Editor__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Date/time format__TRILIUM_PH_7__, using __TRILIUM_PH_8__Day.js format tokens__TRILIUM_PH_9__ (for example __TRILIUM_PH_10__).
Icons__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Icons just like the ones for the __TRILIUM_PH_0__note icon__TRILIUM_PH_1__ can be inserted in text. For more information see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Icons__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
